annotations.title: One BDC's schedule of investments at a quarter end

description: Every position a BDC tagged at one quarter end (the latest unless as_of is given), each in the filer's own figures: borrower, instrument, kind, lien, principal, fair value, cost, spread, PIK, all-in rate, maturity, unfunded commitment. Debt only by default. Paged at 25.

as_of.description: A quarter end (YYYY-MM-DD) on the BDC's tape; default the latest.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page of this tool, unchanged.

dfx_id.description: A dfx:pc:<uuid> BDC id or a CIK.
